description: This file defines the GroupRoleData class, a data structure used to represent roles within a group context in the Fineract system. It includes fields for role identification, associated client information, and a static method for creating a template instance.

classes.name: GroupRoleData
classes.description: A serializable data class representing a role within a group, including role details and client association.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Returns a new instance of GroupRoleData with all fields initialized to null as a template.
